  llms.txt (https://llmstxt.org): a short Markdown map of the site for AI assistants.
  Built from the teaching collection and the book pages, so new courses and books appear
  on their own. Deliberately an index only: no full text of notes or slides (see the
  ds-guard notices on course material). Do not add an llms-full.txt with lecture text.
{%- endcomment -%}
# Point Zero — Sercan Külcü

> Personal academic site of Sercan Külcü, Assistant Professor of Computer Engineering at Giresun University, Turkey. It hosts bilingual (Turkish and English) university courses with interactive slides, lecture notes, practice questions and simulators; free PDF textbooks; research publications; free browser-based tools and games; and essays.

Course material is published only on this site and is copyrighted; link to it rather than copying it. Course pages switch language with `?lang=tr` or `?lang=en`.

{%- endfor %}

## Research
- [Publications]({{ site.url }}/publications/): books, journal articles, conference papers and the PhD thesis, with abstracts and PDFs
- [CV]({{ site.url }}/cv/)

## Tools and games
- [Apps]({{ site.url }}/apps/): free browser-based tools (images, PDFs, tests and utilities); [Turkish versions]({{ site.url }}/araclar/)
- [Games]({{ site.url }}/games/): browser games, including game-theory simulations from the courses; [Turkish versions]({{ site.url }}/oyunlar/)
